risk_flags.description: The contract narrows a broad request into only four specific error paths. That may be fine, but the requester should confirm these are the intended priority cases before work begins.
risk_flags.span: cover each of the four error paths above

risk_flags.description: The exclusion of negative amounts and future dates may leave common CLI input errors unhandled. If the requester expected general CLI validation improvements, this exclusion could under-deliver.
risk_flags.span: No validation of business-logic constraints (e.g. negative amounts, future dates)

verdict.primary_risk: The main risk is that the contract turns a broad request for better CLI error handling into a narrow set of four cases without confirmation.
